The Movie Trailer voice

My Movie Trailer Voice is heard worldwide on TV & Radio including BBC Sport, BBC Radio 1 and many Game Trailers.
The style has been around for years. That deep epic voice made famous by the late great Don La Fontaine and Hal Douglas.


In a World… One Man... One Voice…

My movie voice is regularly used on radio commercials and Movie Trailers on YouTube and the small screen too across the world.
The Big Trailer Voice that makes you wanna watch that film or… buy YOUR Product!
Despite being British I can give you an American and English Movie Trailer Voice. Let me know what you prefer and if it helps, send me some lines and I'll send you a custom sample first. So we know I'm the right voice for the project.
Let me enhance your production, film or event.
Get in touch below and tell me more!



How to order your Movie Trailer Voice

The Movie Trailer Voice became so popular I set up The Movie Trailer Voice Cuts website allowing you to purchase a stack of mp3 Movie Trailer Voice Cliches.
Movie voice cuts in high quality you can use on personal productions. Simply drag the files onto your timeline and start editing. Works great in Final Cut ProX, Adobe Premier and many other video editors.
For commercial use and bespoke lines for your project
please visit the contact us page and tell us more. Please give as much detail as you can including usage and script length. This allows for a more accurate quote quickly.
